name: hcportal_getCategoryDetail2
description: Drill-down feed for the HC admin portal dashboard tiles. Returns ONE rowset of raw typed columns for @categoryId: 0=New Hashers, 1=Event RSVPs, 2=New Events, 3=New Kennels, 4=App Logins, 5=Payments, 6=Portal Access, 7=Errors, 8=Push Notification Log, 9=App Errors (client session logs), 10=PackTrack tracks, 11=AI Tokens, 12=Azure Cost, 13=Run Email, 14=First Sign-in, 100=Version Adoption. An unknown categoryId returns no rowset at all. Window: @days days (0 or NULL = 60 minutes); category 12 uses its own day range. READ UNCOMMITTED with NOLOCK hints. Portal does all formatting; HC5's header metadata rowset is gone. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth (NULL callerParamString); no permission gate. Permission (2026-10-13): platform admins with CanViewMonitor only; otherwise {Success 0, 'Not authorised to view the monitor'}.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: device ID used to look up the authenticated user and device secret. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived cryptographic token validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: Required. Category to retrieve (0-14, 100 — see description). NULL returns 'Null categoryId'; any other unknown value returns no rowset.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Lookback window in days, default 7. 0 or NULL means the last 60 minutes. The cutoff is GETDATE() (datetime2, UTC on Azure SQL) minus @days × 1440 minutes.

parameters.name: hcVersion
parameters.description: Category 100 only: substring the login's HcVersion must contain (LIKE '%…%'). NULL makes the category return no rows.

parameters.name: hcBuild
parameters.description: Category 100 only: second substring HcVersion must contain. NULL makes the category return no rows.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned instead of data on auth failure, NULL @categoryId ('Null categoryId') or a runtime error (the CATCH logs to HC.ErrorLog first).

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: Auth error text, 'Null categoryId', or ERROR_MESSAGE()

rowsets.name: Category0_NewHashers
rowsets.description: categoryId = 0. Hashers created in the window (Hasher.createdAt), newest first. UNION ALL of hashers with no HomeKennelId and hashers joined to their home kennel.

columns.name: homeKennelName
columns.description: Home kennel's KennelName; NULL when the hasher has no HomeKennelId

columns.name: cityFullName
columns.description: City.CityFullName of the HC.City nearest the hasher's HomeGeolocation; NULL when HomeLatitude is the 51.5033 default (London placeholder) or no geolocation

rowsets.name: Category1_EventRsvps
rowsets.description: categoryId = 1. HasherEventMap rows updated in the window, newest first.

columns.name: displayName
columns.description: Hasher.DisplayName when VirginVisitorType = 0, else HasherEventMap.DisplayName NVARCHAR(120)

rowsets.name: Category2_NewEvents
rowsets.description: categoryId = 2. Events created in the window (Event.createdAt), newest first, removed runs included.

columns.name: eventStartDatetime
columns.description: CONVERT(datetimeoffset(7), Event.EventStartLocal): the local wall-clock start presented with a +00:00 offset — not an instant. EventStartLocal (persisted computed DATETIME2(7)) is not in db/schema/tables; its definition is in db/hc6/app/archive/deprecate_fb_datetime_in_hc6.sql.

rowsets.name: Category3_NewKennels
rowsets.description: categoryId = 3. Kennels created in the window, newest first (INNER JOIN City: kennels without a CityId are omitted).

rowsets.name: Category4_AppLogins
rowsets.description: categoryId = 4. HC.LaunchAndLogin rows in the window, newest first, excluding two hard-coded hasher ids (0CDBB109-…, D0B7EF01-…). Rows with a NULL UserId are also excluded (the <> test is UNKNOWN for NULL).

rowsets.name: Category5_Payments
rowsets.description: categoryId = 5. HC.Payment rows created in the window, newest first.

columns.name: displayName
columns.description: Payer Hasher.DisplayName when VirginVisitorType = 0, else HasherEventMap.DisplayName

columns.name: cancelledByDisplayName
columns.description: DisplayName of Payment.CancelledBy_UserId; NULL when not cancelled

columns.name: currencySymbol
columns.description: COALESCE(Kennel.CurrencySymbol, Country.CurrencySymbol); '^' marks where the amount goes

rowsets.name: Category6_PortalAccess
rowsets.description: categoryId = 6. HC.PortalAccess rows in the window, newest first, excluding the two hard-coded hasher ids.

columns.name: kennelName
columns.description: The hasher's home Kennel.KennelName (not the kennel accessed)

rowsets.name: Category7_Errors
rowsets.description: categoryId = 7. HC.ErrorLog rows in the window (updatedAt), newest first. ErrorLog.userId is resolved three ways because writers store different ids there: Hasher.id, Hasher.PublicHasherId, or (portal shim) a Device.id.

columns.name: displayName
columns.description: COALESCE(by Hasher.id, by PublicHasherId, by Device.UserId, '')

rowsets.name: Category8_PushNotificationLog
rowsets.description: categoryId = 8. Visible pushes only (PushLog.IsVisible = 1, matching the 'Push' tile in hcportal_getUsageData), newest first. HC.PushLog is not in db/schema/tables; types from db/hc6/app/archive/HC6.PushLog.migration.sql and HC6.PushLog.AddSenderAndResult.sql.

columns.name: MessageType
columns.description: 'Full Push' or 'Data Only', then ' / ' and PushLog.QueryType NVARCHAR(100). Always 'Full Push / …' since only visible rows are selected

columns.name: DeviceId
columns.description: HC.Device.id whose FcmToken matches PushLog.FcmToken now; NULL once the token was cleared

rowsets.name: Category9_AppErrors
rowsets.description: categoryId = 9. HC.ClientErrorLog rows in the window that HC6.ClientLogAppError classes as an app error (same rule as the 'App Error' tile), newest first.

columns.name: hcVersion
columns.description: Build that wrote the log (AppVersion+'+'+BuildNumber, clients ≥ 3.0.13), else the device's current Version+'+'+BuildNumber, else ''

columns.name: error
columns.description: HC6.ClientLogAppError(ErrorLog): the first qualifying error line

columns.name: errorLines
columns.description: Count of '[ERROR]' occurrences in the log

rowsets.name: Category10_PackTrack
rowsets.description: categoryId = 10. One row per captured track: non-removed HasherEventMap rows with TrackPointCount > 0 whose TrackFirstPointAt is in the window, newest first. Track* columns are not in db/schema/tables; types from db/hc6/app/archive/2026-09-10_alter_HasherEventMap_track_columns.sql and 2026-09-13_alter_HasherEventMap_track_stats.sql.

columns.name: publicUrl
columns.description: https://www.hashruns.org/<slug>/<EventNumber>/packtrack for a counted run whose kennel has a KennelUniqueShortName; NULL otherwise

rowsets.name: Category11_AiTokens
rowsets.description: categoryId = 11. One row per model call in LOG.AiUsage with CalledAt in the window, newest first.

columns.name: session
columns.description: First 8 characters of AiUsage.SessionId (groups one timer run or portal Test)

rowsets.name: Category12_AzureCost
rowsets.description: categoryId = 12. LOG.AzureDailyCost per day per service plus an '(all services)' total per day, with the previous day's figure. The window is NOT @cutoffDate: it is the last 14 days with data when @days >= 7, else the last 2 days, ending at MAX(CostDate). Newest day first, totals row first within a day, then cost descending; services under 0.005 omitted.

columns.name: dayBeforeIncVat
columns.description: Previous day's cost for the same service × VAT; 0 when none

columns.name: status
columns.description: 'complete' when RetrievedAt is at least 2 days after CostDate, else 'still settling'

rowsets.name: Category13_Email
rowsets.description: categoryId = 13. One row per LOG.GeneralLog entry with LogSource 'RunEmail' and valid JSON Data in the window (written by nonApi_recordRunEmailSent; previews and the launch announcement carry their own kind), newest first.

columns.name: Run
columns.description: KennelShortName + ' #' + EventNumber of the event in StrParam1, or ''

columns.name: AuditPath
columns.description: JSON '$.audit' (blob path of the audit copy) or ''

rowsets.name: Category14_FirstSignIn
rowsets.description: categoryId = 14. Accounts whose first ever self sign-in (LaunchAndLogin with errorInfo NULL, UserId set, UserName not '+…+', HcVersion not '<portal>'/'probe') falls in the window, newest first; the two hard-coded hasher ids excluded.

columns.name: signedInWith
columns.description: 'Web (passkey)', 'iOS app', 'Android app' or 'Emailed code (app or web)' from the first row's HcVersion/SystemName

columns.name: hcVersion
columns.description: First row's HcVersion with 'HC Ver: ' removed and ', Bld: ' replaced by '+'. NOTE: taken from the row with MIN(idx), which is assumed to be the row with MIN(LoginDate)

rowsets.name: Category100_VersionAdoption
rowsets.description: categoryId = 100. One row per user who logged in during the window and has at least one LaunchAndLogin row whose HcVersion contains both @hcVersion and @hcBuild; ordered by total logins in the window, descending. Empty when either filter is NULL.

columns.name: updatedAt
columns.description: The user's latest LoginDate in the window (any version)

columns.name: hcVersion
columns.description: LaunchAndLogin.HcVersion of the user's newest login matching the version filter

columns.name: twoWeekCount
columns.description: All the user's logins in the window (named for the default two-week tile, but follows @days)

columns.name: thisVersionCount
columns.description: The user's logins in the window matching the version filter

sideEffects: On a runtime error only: INSERT HC.ErrorLog (ProcName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID), userId = caller)
Calls HC6.nonApi_portalKennelAccess (read-only) for its permission check.

codeSmells.detail: Two hasher GUIDs (0CDBB109-…, D0B7EF01-…) are excluded by literal in several categories (e.g. lines 204-205, 260-261, 518-519), and category 0 treats HomeLatitude 51.5033 as 'no home location'. Undocumented magic values.
The header (lines 16-22) lists categories 0-9, 14 and 100; categories 10-13 (PackTrack, AI Tokens, Azure Cost, Email) are undocumented there.

codeSmells.issue: First sign-in row picked by MIN(idx), time by MIN(LoginDate)
codeSmells.detail: Category 14 (line 497) takes firstIdx and firstLoad as independent aggregates; if a later-idx row has an earlier LoginDate the signedInWith/hcVersion columns describe a different row from firstSignInAt.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change the meaning of categoryId values (0-14, 100)
Never change the column shape of any category without updating all portal callers
Never restore the HC5 header metadata rowset (col1-col6) — callers have been updated to expect raw typed columns
changes: 2026-10-05: category 11 (AI Tokens: one row per model call from LOG.AiUsage) and 12 (Azure Cost per day per service with dayBefore/change, '(all services)' totals; Hour/Day = last 2 days, Week = 14). CATCH now logs to HC.ErrorLog.

2026-10-05 (later): category 12 columns are costIncVat, dayBeforeIncVat, change (inc VAT), costExVat — replacing cost/dayBefore the same day they shipped (generic drill-down table; no client reads them by name).
2026-10-13 contract sweep: per-category rowset schemas written out for all 16 categories (10-14 were undocumented); @days marked nullable (it has a SQL default).
